summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Anil Devgan, presented as a Wikipedia-sourced page. It identifies his family relationships to actors Ajay Devgan and Kajol and his father Veeru Devgan. It also notes that he has worked as a director, directing his brother in two films.
one_line: Anil Devgan is a family member of Bollywood actors Ajay Devgan and Kajol who has worked as a film director.
key_facts: Anil Devgan is the son of Veeru Devgan.
Anil Devgan is the brother of actor Ajay Devgan.
Anil Devgan is the brother-in-law of actress Kajol.
Anil Devgan has tried his hand at directing films.
Anil Devgan directed his brother Ajay Devgan in Raju Chacha.
Anil Devgan directed his brother Ajay Devgan in Blackmail (2005 film).
